name: Faber Talika OC A80 Wall Mounted Chimney Hood
description: The Faber Talika OC A80 is a premium, award-winning Red Dot Design Award wall-mounted chimney hood [citation:1][citation:9]. It features a unique, ultra-slim vertical design (15cm thickness) [citation:5] and is powered by innovative Nautilus technology for high performance with low consumption [citation:1][citation:7]. Ideal for modern kitchens, it is available in an elegant Old Copper finish [citation:1][citation:5].

specifications.material: Metal (Stainless Steel) with Old Copper Finish [citation:1][citation:5][citation:6]
specifications.specialFeatures: Nautilus Technology, Perimeter Aspiration, Intensive Speed (6-min boost), Touch Controls, LED Lighting (3000K), Remote Control Ready [citation:1][citation:5][citation:12]
